summary: Implemented the M2 S3-compatible object storage foundation: StorageConfig (env-driven, secret redacted via SecretStr), PutPolicy (content-type allowlist + 100 MB max, foundation level), ObjectStorage Protocol, and S3ObjectStorage (boto3, injectable client; idempotent put/get/delete/ensure_bucket; presigned GET/PUT with configurable TTL; audit events storage.object_put/storage.object_deleted without data or credentials; botocore ClientError never escapes the API surface). Added boto3>=1.34 to pyproject, 9 stub-based unit tests plus a STORAGE_ENDPOINT-gated MinIO integration test, CI test-job MinIO envs, and the Object storage docs section.
contracts_changed: services/api/clipos_api/storage.py: StorageConfigurationError, ObjectNotFound, PolicyViolation, StorageClientError, StorageConfig, PutPolicy, ObjectStorage (Protocol), S3ObjectStorage, StorageSession

tests.name: pytest
tests.evidence: 146 passed, 2 skipped (both skips are STORAGE_ENDPOINT-gated MinIO integration tests, honestly skipped in the no-network/no-docker sandbox); coverage 88.09% vs 60% floor. Prior count 137; 10 tests added (9 unit + 1 gated integration).

tests.name: ruff_format
tests.evidence: 2 files reformatted during iteration; final run left 30 files unchanged.

tests.name: mypy
tests.evidence: Success: no issues found in 14 source files (boto3/botocore imports carry import-untyped ignores; no stubs package installed).

tests.name: secret_scan
tests.evidence: secret_scan: clean; exit 0. Module contains only env reads; compose dev credentials appear only in CI env matching docker-compose.dev.yml.

tests.name: credential_literal_grep
tests.evidence: No matches; only STORAGE_SECRET_KEY env read and SecretStr redaction.

tests.name: minio_gated_integration
tests.evidence: Sandbox has no network/Docker; the orchestrator must run the CI test job (STORAGE_ENDPOINT set against compose MinIO on localhost:9002, bucket clipos-test, ensure_bucket() creates it).

known_limitations: Foundation-level policy only: prefix/key-shape rules, MIME sniffing of actual bytes, and multipart/resumable uploads (Temporal) are explicitly out of scope for this ticket.
Presign TTL uses the client default (config default 3600s) when per-call ttl_seconds is omitted.
MinIO integration tests are orchestrator/CI-gated; they did not run in this sandbox.
